correctness.rationale: The four fixed points follow from the five Fourier eigenlines and the Fermat sum of powers. Exact tangent derivative removes the unique weight 2k, giving local cyclic type 1/5(1,2,3) at each point. All four Reid–Tai residue sums exceed five. The quotient map is quasi-étale, so canonical pullback gives volume 4/5 and Q-Fano property; Picard rank follows from finite-group rational cohomology transfer. Griffiths residue Jacobian-ring monomials form six free five-cycles, giving h21=6 and b3=12. Chern-class and commuting-pair formulas give Euler numbers -8 and 8. The standard-library checker independently recomputed each finite combinatorial identity.

value.rationale: The natural order-five permutation is a distinguished prime-order symmetry inside the full group of the maximally symmetric Fermat quartic threefold. Its quotient singularity basket, canonical index, volume, complete Betti list and cohomological invariant dimension together supply a meaningful local-to-global classification of a terminal non-Gorenstein Q-Fano threefold; the shrinkage from h21=30 to 6 identifies a nontrivial invariant Hodge factor. No unproved downstream birational or coding theorem is asserted.
